reason: I have never paid for an app; YouTube is free and my child is happy with cartoons. I might download the free part and see, but paying 25 thousand every month for something on my phone is not what I do.
objection: Will my child actually learn letters, or just tap the mascot and play like with any other game? I can't tell that from an advert.
would_change_my_mind: If after a few weeks of the free version my child really started reading letters and counting, and the kindergarten teacher or another mum I trust said PRO is worth it.
